entities.name: profiles
entities.purpose: Human identity without implicit household access
entities.constraints: UNIQUE(auth_subject). Never infer membership from an email domain.

entities.name: households
entities.purpose: Root scope and monotonic safety state
entities.constraints: Epoch/version nonnegative; mode cannot be changed by a client.

entities.name: memberships
entities.purpose: Adult household roles and temporary access
entities.constraints: One active owner; partial unique active household/profile. Scoped arrays require validated membership.

entities.name: pets
entities.constraints: No compatibility, diagnosis, or happiness-score fields.

entities.name: resources
entities.purpose: Named care/retreat resources in a zone

entities.name: pet_resource_access
entities.constraints: Same-household composite references; plan is not proof of actual access.

entities.name: pet_pairs
entities.constraints: pet_a_id < pet_b_id; UNIQUE(household_id,pet_a_id,pet_b_id); no species field that can drift from pets.

entities.name: cases
entities.purpose: Situation record and product support route

entities.name: case_pets
entities.constraints: UNIQUE(household_id,case_id,pet_id); single-pet cases valid.

entities.name: pair_contexts
entities.purpose: Pair outcome within a specific case/context
entities.constraints: Pair pets must be case participants; context-specific status never implies group compatibility.

entities.name: protocols
entities.constraints: UNIQUE(slug). Source material licensing reviewed.

entities.name: protocol_versions
entities.purpose: Immutable authored version with lifecycle gate
entities.constraints: UNIQUE(protocol_id,version,locale). Approved requires attributable review of exact digest.

entities.name: protocol_reviews
entities.constraints: Reviewer credentials/scope verified outside model; no demo fixture asserts approval.

entities.name: source_references
entities.constraints: No full copied guides without license.

entities.name: protocol_sources
entities.constraints: UNIQUE(protocol_version_id,source_id).

entities.name: plan_revisions
entities.constraints: UNIQUE(household_id,case_id,revision_number). No in-place edits of reviewed revisions.

entities.name: plan_steps
entities.purpose: Ordered allowed steps from the applicable protocol
entities.constraints: Ordering does not authorize progression; UNIQUE(plan_revision_id,step_key).

entities.name: plan_reviews
entities.purpose: Owner acknowledgment of exact plan state
entities.constraints: Only household owner; not a clinical clearance.

entities.name: sessions
entities.purpose: One real or fictional guided software session
entities.constraints: One unresolved active/paused/interrupted session per household. Interrupted requires fresh checkpoint, not automatic release.

entities.name: session_pets
entities.constraints: UNIQUE(session_id,pet_id); at least one participant; must be in plan participant digest.

entities.name: observations
entities.purpose: Attributed reports, never unmarked objective truth
entities.constraints: No pet IDs outside case/household; no inferred observed_at=reported_at by default.

entities.name: safety_holds
entities.constraints: Scope explicit; owner cannot clear professional/urgent holds. No duration-based auto-resolution.

entities.name: handover_acks
entities.constraints: UNIQUE(handover_id,profile_id,acknowledged_digest); reading does not establish physical action.

entities.name: task_occurrences
entities.constraints: Exactly one parent; unique parent+occurrence_key; future plan reminders revalidate epoch.

entities.name: task_reports
entities.constraints: Multiple independent reports preserved; no inferred ingestion or action from a notification.

entities.name: action_authorizations
entities.constraints: No arbitrary action from an LLM; changing recipient/content invalidates authorization.

entities.name: share_grants

fields.name: token_hash
fields.meaning: Store hash, not reusable plaintext secret

entities.constraints: Raw token never in analytics; verified recipient does not prove professional qualification.

entities.name: outbox_events
entities.constraints: UNIQUE(household_id,idempotency_key); same transaction as domain event.

entities.name: deliveries
entities.constraints: No delivered claim solely from queue success.

entities.name: audit_events

fields.name: metadata
fields.meaning: Minimal IDs/hashes, not raw voice content

entities.constraints: Append-only to normal application roles; deletion follows explicit privacy policy.

fields.name: usage
fields.meaning: Token/audio totals; no raw prompts by default

entities.name: assets
entities.constraints: Object access derives from application scope, not a guessable path.

entities.name: entitlements
entities.purpose: Future paid capabilities, independent of safety/access roles
entities.constraints: No live R0 payment. Safety and export remain outside quota.
